note: Six exact mux routes, query/body parsing and true respond payloads. Health passes *strings.Reader to generic json.Encoder; no literal message DTO substituted. respondText header is literally text/plain, charset=UTF-8. Both responders write status first then attempt 500 after encoding/write failure.

Import validates market shape/brand; default included years are 2027/2028 for three-character 6xx markets only. Groups PNO3s by market and brand, schedules only requested brands with nonempty PNO3s. Event decode error returns from the whole batch; import errors log and continue. GlobDictJob is declaration only, not a registered processor.

jobChan capacity 100; SendMarketAuthJob nil guard then goroutine send, so normal return is scheduling only; send may block. Run ranges channel and handles only *MarketAuthJob, no context select, channel not closed locally. Processing is serial; error logs then next job. Per-job matched PNO3s processed; others use cached results with fallback reprocess. Unchanged hash/no recalculate cache path can fall through to pipeline on read failure. publishResult requires nonempty market AND both lists; sequential compressed publications can partially complete.

Fetch filter markets once per batch or return. Invalid protobuf/mandatory fields/no CPAM-or-legacy lookup cause per-message continue. CPAM market takes precedence over legacy. ModelYear int32 converted through int to decimal string. Nonempty accumulated list publishes UUID + exact event type; publication errors log. Callback returns void and does not establish broker acknowledgement.

Separate event executable uses filter API, aggregator credentials/group and DedupeEventReaderPolicy. SkipEventWriter chooses real SugaredWriter or local MockEventWriter. AggregatorApp.Run does not consult stored skipEventReader flag; validates nonnil reader/policy then starts error listener and reader goroutines and waits for cancellation.

HTTP executable constructs real Azure storage; optional reader flag controls construction/start. Real/mock writer selected by SkipEventWriter. Orchestrator/API/reader goroutines share cancel; no main-to-every-handler eager call. App validates policy even when reader skipped.

Local executable writes under localStorage, opens ./marketauthfiles/mkt-test.txt with os.Open and invokes pipeline with Input.Id=test, background context; no local Close of input file. Makefile builds HTTP/event only; Docker entrypoint HTTP, not evidence pipeline is deployed.

Readers validate nonempty server/topic/group. NewReader options disable SSL verification, max.poll.interval.ms=3600000, earliest offsets. WithHandler exact event types known; header field/SDK activation/commit unknown. AggregationPeriod nonempty required; parse failure defaults ten minutes, zero/negative values not locally rejected.

Configured Azure client/container. CreateContainer treats ContainerAlreadyExists as nil, other errors returned. Write UploadBuffer failure can trigger archived check, DeleteBlob then one UploadBuffer retry, each error returned, non-atomic deletion window. Read obtains DownloadStream body, defer Close, ReadAll. Flat pager More/NextPage collects Name pointers, errors abort.

LocalStorage.Write creates directories, only literal prefix configrulesets triggers LZ4 decode -> protobuf ConfigRuleSet -> JSON -> numeric component-type names. os.WriteFile acknowledgement requires err nil. Local Read lacks context and does not implement HTTP ReadWriter. modifyType logs JSON decode error but continues; type assertions may panic. No runtime filesystem state inferred.

PublishMessage proto.Marshal error returned. PublishCompressedMessage proto.Marshal error logs then returns nil without publish. Compression uses GZIP for messages, distinct from LZ4 rule files. Both warn above 1000000 bytes but still publish. NewEvent uses actual bytes/id/eventType; SDK Publish returned error checked. Broker persistence and consumption remain unknown.
Mock performs encoding/compression/logging and returns errors without Kafka. It is the SkipEventWriter true branch, with no network edge or broker acknowledgement.
Exact event type map sends MarketAuthsUpdated to CPAM_TOPIC; spec-market compressed/uncompressed and PNO12 components to CONFIG_POLICY_TOPIC. Unknown type log.Fatalf; no guessed default topic.

Nine configured parsers run on every scanned ASCII-normalised line; parser errors warn and continue, scanner.Err not checked. Four verifiers start goroutines, then ReadErrors receives per-verifier unbuffered channel result. All configured verifier severities WARNING, though pipeline ERROR guard exists. Five converters run in registered order and warn/continue on returned errors. Two actions run in order; action error aborts. No automatic heap/channel state proof.

ExtractFields guards length>=3, checks record prefix, compiles exact regexp, trims trailing spaces; RecordLength field not enforced. Parsers marshal named fields then unmarshal typed record and append. ICR blank week groups become string zero. Patterns and JSON string-number tags retained as source declarations.

Split scopes per variant/week; scope SHA caches rules; rules errors logged but available rules uploaded. Ten-worker pool starts goroutine per unique ruleset, waits via imported goccm and buffered error channel; last nonnil receive error returned. LZ4 protobuf rulesets written before JSON import manifest. Metadata grouped variant/week includes timestamp, legacy PNO12, SW path/hash; ICA cardinality error logged, still assigns empty timestamp. Thirteen subrules, two conditionally registered; OneOrNone helper not registered.

Registered bound method values invoked in goroutines; exact count n then receives rules and errors n times on separate unbuffered channels, closes channels afterwards. Results from separate channels have no guaranteed pair ordering across workers; no broker handoff is inferred.

ICS defines per-PNO12 map of core variant components plus optional edition. Unknown data element aborts; styling splits color/upholstery; H/P flags source-set. Deduplicated mapping list JSON encoded and saved as Pno12ComponentMapping-id only when nonempty; source market error ignored.

Skip fetch for 824/P02; otherwise per-ICV goroutines background context, waitgroup and buffered channel; failures log and skip that result. Standard wheel creates $F feature code component, S-standard ICS and bidirectional forbid ICRs. Then wheel heuristics mutate ICC/ICS/ICR/ICP data element to055. Exact code list/regex exclusions retained, not execution observations.

Feature flag chooses carspec API with background context or exact static table; API error logs and returns nil local editions. Conversion matches option code case-insensitively, excludes H, copies variant records with Edition then adds H-records and merges. Hardcoded table is declaration, not remote state.

Clamp ICV/ICR/ICS end week for equal external variant when period exceeds five*365 days; calculated clamp uses AddDate five years. Source intent/exact expressions retained, no calendar equivalence inferred.

Reject duplicate ICV variant before splitting. Keep weeks with styling pairs, sort decreasing then stack/pop increasing, construct contiguous periods, copy ICV per period. Empty-week stack can propagate nil receiver; source has no explicit empty guard in constructPeriodsFromWeeks.
Only Austria233 and non-Polestar; removes H-standard local L options after nonempty ICV/ICZ guards; ICM[0] access has no separate cardinality check.

GCC->CPAM mapping with CPAM self-map fallback; spec-market response truncation causes error. PNO3 dedup excludes2019 and MY2028 car416/417, requested years and mismatched markets. MarketAuth rewriting uses unchecked fixed line slices and ignores scanner.Err; closes source body only after successful rewrite.

Three GET contracts query/header source parts retained. MarketAuth returns response body without defer close (caller owns success close); non2xx path does not locally close. Other methods defer close and JSON decode; SpecMarket total>take returns result plus error.
GET /v2/allPolicyUids with context; JSON decode but no HTTP status check.

POST configured full URL with source SOAP-like XML envelope; user-key header; no Content-Type or HTTP status check. Body read/close and XML decode error returned. NewRequest option list deliberately contains000000; response selects nested StdFeaturesCU despite Error field.
POST exact JSON payload with four lower-case tags, content-type application/json; context, non2xx error guard and JSON response decode.
GET local-editions with specMarket/modelYear/carType query, non2xx guard and whole response wrapper decode; caller selects Data.LocalEditions then constructs validated local source objects.
Exact legacy market map210->221 etc declared; response ModelYear int converted to string, original requested market retained in LocalEditionCar; validation errors abort whole response.

POST form grant_type/client_id/client_secret/resource. No request context or HTTP status check. Partial embedded oauth2.Token plus ExpiresIn string; Atoi error returns; only positive expiry seconds sets Expiry.

Reusable local transport wrapper, not a deployed remote service. Default120-second timeout, cloned provided client, custom wrappers applied in reverse to obtain FIFO; default transport cloned with three connection limits100. Do forwards actual request with null unresolved remote target.

Value receiver scalar fields copied; shared header/query maps mutated. Build calls req.WithContext before checking NewRequest error. Header map assigned, query Add preserves potential prior values; encode afterwards.

SkipLaunchDarkly returns noop local client/default flag results. Real BoolVariation may be cached SDK evaluation; no asserted network call. Local flag errors log/fallback false; two actual flags and attribute maps retained.
Exact source car-type set chooses PCF else CPAM, closest structure week with temporary256/H5/MY2024 override. Both concrete feature fetchers retained under guarded source object alternatives.

Full source records/embedded fields, brand/skip maps, data append/merge/split, PNO12 formatting and week validation retained. Split errors on missing MY/carType or variant/noICV/overlap; ModelYear/CarType use unchecked ICC[0]. Data hash ignores JSON marshal errors, excludes wheel-feature map/local editions; Merge overwrites LocalEditionCars.

Source grouping copies input slices then stable sort via local comparison closure; interface implementations ICP/ICR retained as alternatives. FindIcv multiple matches errors, zero matches returns empty record nil. Blank-standard ICS correspondence exact five-field equality.

Per-variant/week scope uses first matching ICV, all ICA/ICC/ICM/ICN/ICZ, same-variant zero-period-or-in-range ICS/ICR; ICP included only when package ICS available. Computes source SHA, carries local editions after scope creation.

Rule IDs mutated only if empty; HashConfigRules starts a len-sized empty-string slice then appends IDs, sorts copied strings and hashes formatting. Component/subcondition sorting and exact rule string retained; no inferred cryptographic/runtime state.

UTC+1 fixed Swedish normal time, no DST. Inclusive ranges/overlap, nearest week, iterator expressions exact; AllWeeks includes start even if reversed period, NextWeek returns next without mutating current. Imported timex implementation unknown.
Full source rune switch and ASCII fallback retained; strings.Map imported callback invocation policy remains an association to source toASCII, no invented eager invocation.
